ABA Data Collection Software Simplified

Leverage RethinkBH’s comprehensive clinical tools to streamline your ABA therapy practice.

Request A Demo

Easy to Implement, Simple to Use

Our ABA data collection software and clinical tools make the lives of clinicians, teachers, and ABA Therapy Business leaders easier by automating repetitive tasks and streamlining reports. Whether you are using our ABA data collection app or the web version, spend less time taking notes and filling out reports equals more spent on improving care for their students.

Implement Clinical Best Practices

RethinkBH's customizable curriculum includes over 1,500 treatment goals with video-based training embedded to ensure fidelity when implementing with your clients.

Leverage Data and Insights

RethinkBH's mobile app allows for easy data collection online or offline with immediate syncing capability to allow for real time data analysis.

Secure Your Data (HIPAA)

Your data is always safe, secure and easily accessible with full Electronic Health Record (EHR) & document management.

Medical Necessity Assessment

RethinkBH's patent pending Medical Necessity Assessment offers your practice a training resource to guide clinicians in suggesting ABA doses, enhancing reimbursement from funders.

Frequently Asked Questions

How does digital data collection improve ABA therapy outcomes?

Digital data collection provides real-time, accurate insights into client progress. This enables faster treatment adjustments, reduces human error, and improves collaboration with families. Features like automated graphs, HIPAA-compliant portals, and parent participation support better outcomes and engagement.

How does RethinkBH compare to BehaviorSoft for ABA data collection?

RethinkBH is a full practice management and training platform with robust ABA data collection tools, real-time entry, and collaboration features. BehaviorSoft is simpler, focusing on easy setup, data collection, and basic practice management. RethinkBH can be implemented from startup ABA practices to larger practices needing comprehensive tools and training, while BehaviorSoft suits smaller clinics wanting straightforward, efficient solutions.

Can I customize clinical care plans in RethinkBH?

Yes, RethinkBH allows for customization of clinical care plans. You can tailor these plans to meet the specific needs of your practice or the individuals you are supporting. This includes modifying goals, interventions, data collection methods, and clinical care plans to suit your clinical requirements. View our Knowledge Base or Contact us for guidance on customization options.

Key Features and Benefits

Treatment Planning Library

Includes over 1,500 customizable protocols with corresponding video-based training and teaching materials for staff and parents. Our VB-MAPP integration allows clinicians to not only complete the assessment in RethinkBH but select curriculum goals that align with client recommended treatment.

Analytics When You Need Them

And on-demand! Our clinical dashboards provide insights at the micro and macro levels to improve your clinical outcomes.

Data Collection at Your Fingertips

RethinkBH’s mobile app allows for easy data collection online or offline with immediate syncing capability to allow for real time data analysis. Frequency/Rate, duration, opportunity-based, interval, and task analysis data can are available on the website and mobile app.

Increase Family Engagement with our Parent Portal

Provide caregivers with resources to track their child’s progress, share documents with their child’s care team, sign off on session notes, and access on-demand training resources.

“A Day in the Life”

Check out how an RBT completes a session using RethinkBH’s mobile app.

What People Are Saying

More than anything, it’s given our BCBAs confidence in conversations with payors, and they aren’t second-guessing their own recommendation because they have the tool to confirm this is what the patient needs. That confidence is really important for new BCBAs and those who may be going through their first peer review.
